description: JavaScript code for manipulating and adjusting timezone display in gitweb output, including UI elements for timezone selection and date adjustment functions.

methods.name: onloadTZSetup
methods.description: Initializes timezone settings on page load, setting cookies, adding UI, and adjusting dates.

methods.name: fixDatetimeTZ
methods.description: Replaces RFC-2822 date strings in specified elements with adjusted timezone dates.

methods.name: addChangeTZ
methods.description: Adds UI triggers for changing timezone in the gitweb output.

methods.name: createChangeTZForm
methods.description: Creates the UI form for selecting a timezone.

methods.name: removeChangeTZForm
methods.description: Removes the timezone selection UI from the DOM.

methods.name: displayChangeTZForm
methods.description: Displays the timezone selection UI at the target element.

methods.name: generateTZList
methods.description: Generates a list of timezone options for selection.

methods.name: generateTZOptions
methods.description: Creates <option> elements for each timezone for the select UI.

methods.name: selectTZHandler
methods.description: Event handler for selecting a timezone and updating display.

methods.name: closeTZFormHandler
methods.description: Event handler for closing the timezone selection UI.
